name: Mariner Corporation Limited
summary: Mariner Corporation Limited engages in the investment activities in Australia. The company maintains positions in various non-derivative financial instruments. Its portfolio comprises quoted equity investments, fixed and variable interest loans, and investments in other schemes. The company also invests in properties, loan books, agricultural assets, aged care, office buildings, subdivision developments, and others; and a portfolio of plant and equipment rental assets. Mariner Corporation Limited is based in North Sydney, Australia.
